result.summary: Found 1 clear visual defect: the restaurant name in the first 'Popular right now' card is clipped, even though there is plenty of horizontal space. The rest of the layout (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, bottom navigation) renders correctly. Partially visible carousel items and cards cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected and were not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off and reads as 'Tokumaru Rameı'. The right portion of the final 'n' is missing, even though there is ample free space between the title and the rating (4.8 (500+)). The text container appears to have a fixed or miscalculated width, or an overflow clip that truncates the last glyph without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Let the title container size to its content, or use flex-grow with min-width: 0 so it fills the space available next to the rating. Remove the hard clip, or use text-overflow: ellipsis so truncation is signalled clearly. Verify that width measurement accounts for the font's final glyph and any letter spacing.
